'File:' = a specific file, 'Category:' = search that category (largest suitable file wins). tool/fetch_photos.dart checks the licence of each file through the Commons API and only accepts CC0, public domain, CC BY and CC BY-SA. Candidates were found by web search on 2026-10-05; the licence check happens at fetch time.
